Overview

Vejle is a city in Southern Denmark with a population of 58,000. A picturesque city at the head of Vejle Fjord, known for its iconic Wave building, shopping, and nature trails. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
